summary: Duel arena iteration 5 refines coarse Meshy foliage into editable Blender needle clusters and replaces matching side trees with one mature central pine. Following Alfredo’s correction, the full crown, trunk and roots are now visible on level garden ground. Wider review framing and a lower optical center give the tree headroom while the 3D stage and cards share the same projection canvas. Blender camera matches the native composition. Mat/lantern geometry and all original maps remain intact. Shared classification covers tooling/documentation only; no rules, state or protocol changes.

Final clear 1920x1080, normal 1600x900 and crowded 1280x800 (six attachments, bow/reveal/sidebar) captures passed and were visually inspected. Every imported tree vertex fits inside the native viewport with a margin at default zoom; normal bounds x674.876..927.264, y27.569..369.730; crowded x431.921..593.449, y153.644..372.627. Normal/crowded 14/22 card faces remain in viewport/on silk; native projected clicks opened the correct card once; max camera error 0.000123px. Earlier same-iteration neutral pine front/reverse and v4 comparisons and both launchers passed; foliage/detail cameras are unchanged by the framing correction. One runtime PineHero; 27 meshes/364,413 scene triangles. All seven original maps preserved by hash; mat/lantern geometry, UVs and transforms unchanged. Original source/cleanup hashes verified, lossless mipmapped imports retained, preexisting project.godot byte-identical. Python compilation and diff checks passed. No additional Meshy requests or credits. Previous push passed Mac/Windows CI, handoff and review routing; final correction CI will be checked after push.
remaining: Final human art acceptance, remaining architecture/garden detail, atmosphere/transitions, full performance qualification, live duel integration and native Windows graphical acceptance remain. Original Meshy branch simplification still appears in close-up; foliage separation is authored approximation. FPS counters are brief observations, not a controlled benchmark.
